zh.summary: 为大规模 AI 计算集群开发强调故障隔离的光互连。
zh.judgment: 这是基础设施技术路线，采购价值取决于集群级可靠性与兼容性，公开规格仍有限。
zh.replaces: 数据中心依赖现有互连方案处理加速器间通信，并应对节点故障拖累任务。
zh.product: 官网说明用光互连限制故障影响，让计算持续运行。没有取得完整产品规格、实测带宽或公开部署手册，不能把产品主张写成已达成性能。
zh.customer: 大规模 AI 集群运营商及硬件集成商是合理买方推断。它服务系统采购而非普通应用用户，成本与风险通常需要放到整个计算集群中评估。
zh.workflow: 可研究的流程是集群通信需求建模、硬件与软件集成、故障测试和运维验收。具体接口与兼容范围尚不明，本次不能给出已验证部署步骤。
zh.business_model: 未披露公开价格和合同模式。硬件销售、系统集成或许可属于商业假设，制造良率、供应链和长期支持成本可能影响毛利。
zh.traction: 一手页面支持技术定位，但未取得独立集群测试或具名客户验收。融资与出隐身状态不能代替商用部署、收入或故障恢复证明。
zh.moat: 潜在壁垒在系统设计、集成知识与可靠性验证，而非“光”这个标签。既有互连供应链和成熟采购标准是重要竞争条件。
zh.funding_read: 融资为研发和验证提供资源，下一里程碑应是可比较的系统测试及设计导入。资金用途细目和量产计划未确认，不推测已完成生产。
zh.risks: 实验指标可能不能反映真实集群负载，兼容性和供应周期也可能延迟导入。新硬件若增加运维复杂度，可能抵消可靠性收益。
zh.takeaway: 用客户的故障影响和恢复时间定义技术价值。将芯片或器件指标连接到整个任务完成率，避免只展示孤立峰值。
zh.watch_next: 看端到端吞吐、故障隔离、能耗、设计导入和客户验收。公开规格与独立负载测试将比新增融资更能减少产品不确定性。

en.summary: Optical interconnect for large AI clusters, emphasizing containment of hardware failures.
en.judgment: Procurement value depends on system reliability and compatibility; public specifications remain limited.
en.replaces: Operating existing accelerator interconnects while managing node failures that interrupt workloads.
en.product: The site describes optical interconnect that contains failures so computation continues. Complete specifications, measured bandwidth and deployment manuals were not retrieved; the proposition is not verified performance.
en.customer: Large cluster operators and hardware integrators are plausible buyers. This is a system-procurement product, with costs and risks assessed across a cluster rather than by an ordinary app user.
en.workflow: A workflow to investigate is communication requirements, integration, fault testing and operational acceptance. Specific interfaces and compatibility remain unclear; no validated installation procedure can be given.
en.business_model: Public prices and contract terms were unavailable. Hardware sales, integration or licensing are hypotheses. Yield, supply chains and ongoing support could affect margin.
en.traction: Primary material establishes positioning without independent cluster testing or named customer acceptance. Financing and leaving stealth do not prove deployment, revenue or recovery quality.
en.moat: System design, integration knowledge and reliability validation could be defensible. Existing interconnect ecosystems and procurement standards are important competitive conditions.
en.funding_read: Capital supports development and testing. Comparable system benchmarks and design wins are useful next milestones; detailed allocation and production schedules were not established.
en.risks: Lab results may not represent real workloads, while compatibility and supply cycles can delay adoption. Added operational complexity could offset reliability benefits.
en.takeaway: Define technical value through failure impact and recovery. Connect component metrics to completed workloads rather than displaying isolated peaks.
en.watch_next: Watch end-to-end throughput, failure containment, energy, design wins and customer acceptance. Specifications and independent workload tests would reduce uncertainty more than another round.
